sentences.en: The children were huddled about the fire in shivering groups.
sentences.zh: 孩子们围着火堆瑟瑟发抖地聚集在一起。

sentences.en: Give me your tired, your poor, your huddled masses yearning to breathe free.
sentences.zh: 给我贫穷的、困苦的、拥挤的人们，他们渴望自由。

sentences.en: Several children were huddled around the fire.
sentences.zh: 几个孩子围着火堆挤成一团。

senses.zh: 把...挤在一起；使缩成一团；草率了事
